releases.title: First release
notes: First public release, for Windows 10 version 21H2 or later and Windows 11 on 64-bit (x64) PCs.

Quick scan of NTFS, FAT12, FAT16, FAT32 and exFAT volumes recovers deleted files with their original names, folders and dates. On FAT, a short name such as DSC_0412.JPG loses its first letter, which is shown as _ (_SC_0412.JPG).
Deep scan recognises 21 file types by their content, after a format, on drives Windows shows as RAW and on damaged file systems.
Lost partitions can be found from surviving file-system headers and scanned, without rewriting the partition table.
Preview, a recoverability rating and a content check for every result before you recover it.
Recovered files are always saved to a different drive; the drive you recover from is only ever read.
Drive health from SMART data and Windows' storage reliability counters.
Free edition with up to 1 GB of recovery; Professional, Business, Technician and Enterprise licences, activated online or offline.
English and Spanish; light and dark themes.

This first build is not yet code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC". Choose More info, then Run anyway, and compare the installer's SHA-256 with the one on the download page. A signed build will follow and will reach existing installations as an update.
